acceptanceCriteria: a guard in an importing package is found within a stated bound, with a fixture and a mutation proving it
body: Residual from the V1-1266 lane (PR #944, head 5f98009ae, TCQ-V0-062 corvint cem verify --guarding-tests). Guard discovery stops at the hunk's own package directory, so a guarding test in another package (for example cmd/corvint tests guarding internal/... code) is never a candidate. Expected: candidates can include tests in importing packages within a bounded closure. Actual: only same-directory TestX declarations are considered. Recorded as a limit in TCQ-V0-062.
title: cem verify --guarding-tests only searches the hunk's own directory for guards
